reporting-org.narrative: The Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria

title.narrative: Strengthening of HIV and Tuberculosis (“TB”) national systems of prevention, treatment, care and support in the Republic of Mongolia. - Mongolia (01-Jan-2024-31-Dec-2026)

description.narrative: Mongolia, TB/HIV, Ministry of Health of Mongolia (MOH Mongolia)This program has the following goals: To reduce TB mortality by 50% in 2026 compared to what was reported in 2015. To diagnose 70% of people living with HIV by 2026. To reduce the incidence of HBV and HCV by 90% by 2030. The objectives of this program are: To notify at least 45% of all estimated TB cases by 2026. To achieve at least 90% of people with TB provided with universal drug susceptibility testing by 2026. To achieve a treatment success rate of at least 91% for all form of TB by 2026. To achieve a treatment success rate of at least 80% for RR/MDR-TB by 2026. To achieve ART coverage at least 63% of PLHIV by 2026. To maintain VL at 95% among people who are on ART by 2026. To reduce Hepatitis B virus incidence to 0.3 per 100,000 population by 2026.
